why: One definition per semantic value. Components reference tokens; they never carry raw hex or raw sizes. A test asserts that the committed scene contains colours only from this file.

typography.why: Exactly four tiers. Nothing in a component picks its own size.
notes: The prompt asked for a 22-26 px unit and an 18-20 px label. One CAPTION tier at 22 px satisfies the unit and is 2 px above the label suggestion; those two are separated by opacity, not by a fifth size.
The speed unit is part of the speed component and renders at CAPTION, baseline-aligned to the bottom of the DISPLAY number.

animation.why: Timings the scene may use. Vehicle panel sequences are asset-driven; everything else is a short fade so a state change is legible without motion.

vehicle.why: The brake, headlight and running lamps come from the Model A asset itself, not from a colour token; the asset carries its own light.

measurements.why: Measured from the committed Model A renders. Golden numbers so layout maths does not depend on reading PNGs; the QA re-measures when the assets are present and fails on drift.
measurements.open_union_note: Union over base, brake, headlight, running, all four doors, frunk, trunk and both indicator sequences. The frunk lid is what reaches y=21; the trunk indicator variant reaches x=50.
